summary: @or-sdk/cards preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases at install time, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-compiled CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) using mangled identifiers, a shuffled numeric string-array (`n7gIxM`), and a rotation routine (`WV8StW`) — classic string-array/control-flow obfuscation whose behavior cannot be determined without execution. Bun is pulled specifically because the payload is Bun-compiled and cannot be executed by the Node toolchain, so standard Node-based inspection of what runs on the installer's host is bypassed. The package advertises only a Cards SDK against a data-hub URL and has no documented need for a second language runtime at install time. The combination of an alternate-runtime dropper at preinstall, an obfuscated payload shipped alongside the loader, and a purpose mismatch between the stated SDK role and the delivery mechanism matches the install-time remote-code-execution pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
